components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Amber tournament button used for direct piece manipulation (90° Drehen, Spiegeln) and room joining.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #f59e0b; border: 1.5px solid #fde68a; color: #141311; border-radius: 9px; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.34); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Emerald Progression Button
components.description: High-contrast emerald button for starting rounds and triggering hints.
components.css: .ds-btn-emerald { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #34d399; border: 1.5px solid #a7f3d0; color: #02180b; border-radius: 9px; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.34); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-emerald:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Live Gate-Board Opponent Row
components.description: Live re-ranking opponent strip with Saville-inspired color-block piece progress encoding.
components.html: #1Savannen-Fuchs3 Pkt
components.css: .ds-gate-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; background: #1e1c18; border: 1px solid #38332b; border-radius: 9px; padding: 6px 10px; color: #f5f2eb; font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-rank { color: #f59e0b; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; } .ds-hues { display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-hues i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: #141311; border: 1px solid #38332b; } .ds-pts { color: #c4bba8; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Ticket Room Code Input
components.description: Monospaced room-code field embedded inside the perforated ivory P2P ticket.
components.css: .ds-ticket-input { width: 88px; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #b5ae9c; border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 8px; color: #1c1a16; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; } .ds-ticket-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rule Selector Pill
components.description: Compact segmented toggle for board difficulty (3/4/5 Teile) and hourglass duration (30s/60s/90s).
components.css: .ds-pill-active { background: #d97706; border: 1px solid #fbbf24; border-radius: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #141311; font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.northStar: The Tournament Speed-Table & Split-Flap Gate Board
narrative.overview: UBONGO! Online Speed-Table treats the screen as a physical tournament puzzle table viewed from directly overhead. Rather than burying gameplay behind mobile menu cards, the first viewport launches straight into the active workspace: a warm obsidian slate table (#141311) and basalt panels (#1e1c18) framing a high-contrast, die-cut warm ivory puzzle well (#efece4).
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast material polarity between the warm obsidian table (#141311) and the recessed warm ivory board well (#efece4) and perforated P2P boarding pass.
Authentic 12-hue KOSMOS Ubongo polyomino palette with inner top-edge highlights and integer-aligned grid cells.
Color-blind-safe 90-degree SVG cross-hatch overlay on invalid or overlapping drop targets.
Single-viewport portrait ergonomics where hourglass, opponent ticker, puzzle well, gesture toolbar, dealt hand, and P2P ticket fit within 390x844 without vertical scrolling.

rules.name: The Ivory Polarity Rule
rules.body: Warm ivory (#efece4) is reserved strictly for the recessed target puzzle well, the perforated P2P room ticket, and the match winner banner. Never dilute that contrast by adding decorative light cards elsewhere on the dark table.

rules.name: The Cross-Hatch Conflict Rule
rules.body: Invalid or overlapping polyomino placements must never rely on red fill alone; always pair translucent crimson with the 90-degree diagonal SVG cross-hatch pattern.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional label, badge, piece code, or gesture hint may ever render below 0.75rem (12px).

dos: Do keep the active puzzle board, hourglass timer, opponent ticker, transform controls, dealt pieces, and P2P ticket visible in the first viewport without requiring a menu screen first.
Do use authored SVG icons in a consistent 2px stroke weight for all controls, player emblems, and gemstones.
Do support both multi-touch gestures (Doppeltipp = Spiegeln, 2-Finger-Tipp / Drehgeste = 90° Drehen) and visible 1-tap toolbar buttons for accessibility.
donts: Don't use colored glow box-shadow halos on dark backgrounds; use neutral black elevation shadows.
Don't use Unicode emoji as UI icons, player avatars, or gemstone indicators.
Don't add uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above section headings.
